business.name: Corella
business.tagline: Small hotels in Sydney and the Blue Mountains
business.headline: Three small hotels, each in a building with a past.
business.intro: A 1920s printworks in Surry Hills, a 1938 apartment block above Bondi, and a Blackheath guesthouse that has taken guests since 1911. Book direct and breakfast is on us.

hero.photoAlt: A dim hotel lounge with tall windows and a low sofa

team.name: Surry Hills
team.role: 32 rooms in a 1920s printworks, and Printer's, our dining room

team.name: Bondi
team.role: 18 rooms above the beach, with a pool on the roof

team.name: Blackheath
team.role: 12 rooms and a timber cottage, ten minutes from the cliff walks

about.title: Kept, not converted
about.body: We buy buildings with a history and keep as much of it as we can: the printworks' sawtooth roof, the terrazzo stairs in Bondi, the pressed-metal ceilings in Blackheath. Then we add very good beds, quiet air conditioning and a bar worth staying in for.
